definition: Gain = NeST minus reference for PSNR/CLIP-I; reference minus NeST for all distances. Positive is better.
population: 500 matched source IDs per cell. E1 source values already average three channel events retaining failures; E2 uses the frozen per-source values including the Ada generation-repeat average.
scope: Offline descriptive recomputation only; no new model execution, channel simulation or significance claims.
